name: IEC capacitive proximity sensor: capacitive switch, normally open
aliases: capacitive proximity sensor Capacitive Switch, Normally Open
summary: Capacitive proximity sensor form: Capacitive Switch, Normally Open.
description: A capacitive proximity sensor detects a change of capacitance caused by a target entering its sensing field. This entry identifies the capacitive switch, normally open form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

A vessel wall or nearby material can change the measured capacitance and indicate a level or presence condition. The normally-open designation starts with a non-conducting output or open contact in the documented reference condition; operation changes that state.
Material, mounting, contamination and adjustment affect operation; a capacitive mark does not guarantee detection through every container or medium.
